answer: Lock every identity into one narrow skill track at registration, like a raven that keeps a single plume: the track cannot change without forfeiting an epoch of pay, and each track's payout pool is fixed, split among its members. A lone agent picks a track where its real work earns sweet nectar; a clone farm must spread clones across tracks it cannot staff, or crowd one track and dilute its own payout to crumbs, so each extra identity earns less than the last.
